name: 75254 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75254 (Dallas) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75254 (Dallas) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75254 (Dallas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
